items.title: Five women killed every hour by family members or partners — UN report
items.desc: On average, 129 women or girls were killed every day in 2025 by someone in their close social circle, UN data showed.

items.title: Bombed factories, billion-dollar opportunity: Why German companies are staying in Ukraine
items.desc: German companies remain committed to Ukraine despite million-dollar losses, an unreliable energy supply and a shortage of skilled workers. They are betting on new markets and long-term growth.

items.title: How cautious investors are struggling to avoid the AI bubble
items.desc: From Nvidia to Coreweave, AI and tech stocks have swung sharply in recent months. Some investors still see plenty of room to run, while others are trying to diversify — and finding it harder than expected.

items.title: Nato chief vows defence against space threat after Russian nuclear satellite reports
items.desc: German media said Russia planned to launch a satellite with a nuclear warhead into space in coming weeks.

items.title: Muxuu wadahadalka dadka u sii yaraanayaa sannad kasta, maxayse khubaradu u walaacayaan?
items.desc: Waxaa laga yaabaa inaadan adigu dareemin, laakiin xogtu waxay muujinaysaa in dadku ay sannadba sannadka ka dambeeya si aad u sii yaraanaysa u wada hadlaan sida daraasad lagu ogaaday
